verdict.rationale: Appwrite's own docs say its managed PostgreSQL database offering comes with backups, replicas, pooling, and PITR. That is a first-party capability, but it appears only as a one-line marketing mention scoped to the dedicated PostgreSQL product. Nothing in the pack shows equivalent coverage for the default managed Databases, Storage files, or self-hosted deployments. Missing for 10: detailed docs on automated backup scheduling, retention, and restore workflow; evidence that backups/PITR cover the core managed databases and storage; any independent or hands-on corroboration.
